To evaluate the validity of claimed tasks using worker reports within our 5-stage pipeline, apply this operational checklist. This process relies on evidence-backed traceability, not inferred performance.

### 1. Identity & Provenance Verification (Stage 1 Radar)
- [ ] **Hash Matching:** Verify the worker report’s reported input/output hashes against the actual stored artifacts in the Library vault.
- [ ] **Timestamp Correlation:** Match the worker activity timestamp with the documented `created_date` of the event record.
- [ ] **Authority Check:** Confirm the worker report matches a specifically authorized task ID from the `owner-workspace` log; ignore undocumented claims.

### 2. Pipeline Alignment Audit (Stage 2–4 Forge)

# Fraymus PDF evidence intake · implementation and backend checks

Implemented in Knowledge → Library. PDF originals and extraction manifests are privately stored. Original hashes and per-page extraction hashes are separate. Existing signed dispatch and fixed UTF-8 corpus reader were not changed.

Backend observations (26 October 2026):
- Supplied Part A: 2,841,641 bytes, 100 pages, 175,751 extracted characters, 100 cited references.
- Supplied Part B: 128,191 bytes, 15 pages, 25,293 extracted characters, 15 cited references.
- Both source SHA-256 values match the original attachment hashes recorded before intake. Both stored extraction manifests and every extracted page hash were independently recomputed and matched.
- Repeat Part B intake reused its existing extraction/reference IDs.
- Non-owned/nonexistent workspace rejected with HTTP 404.
- Malformed and password-encrypted fixtures rejected with HTTP 422 and specific reason codes.
- A no-text fixture retained the original/manifest, reported unsupported_scanned and indexed zero text references.
- A valid in-bounds long page extracted 15,857 characters into three chunks; its end-of-page marker survived.
- Frontend build and targeted lint checks exited successfully. Browser interaction/download rendering was not exercised here.

Limitations: text-layer extraction only, no OCR/page images or visual fidelity proof. Font/CMap warnings appeared in parser logs; glyph completeness is not claimed. File limits are 10 MiB original, 250 pages, 1,000,000 text characters, 4 MiB manifest and 400 reference chunks. This intake does not install capability-parity scoring, claim-classification AI, cross-PDF overlap analysis, WASM lowering or autonomous media rendering.

Temporary fixture records/references were removed; the two real source PDFs, their derived manifests and cited references remain. Existing manually curated comparison notes remain unchanged.
